_about: Slice settings (docs/slice/slice_tech_plan.md 2.1, 2.4, Decision 3). default_mode: what a run with no --classic, --sandbox or --slice word and no feature tag boots (classic, slice or sandbox); it stays classic until the slice has rooms to boot, VS-35 flips it. new_game: where a slice New Game starts when slice/rooms.json has no start_room (the Level Designer's room ids replace these). UNUSED today (B16): rooms.json has a start_room, so new_game.room and new_game.spawn are never read (the start is that room's default_spawn, 'start'; 'default' here is not even a real spawn); they are kept as the fallback GameState._new_game_data copies only if start_room is ever removed. new_game.hacks and the other new_game keys ARE used. retry: Decision 2 (knock-out), recommended A. interact: Decision 3 (the talk button), recommended A: mode attack_button = the attack button talks when a prompt shows and no living enemy is within clear_m metres (in town it only talks); mode own_button = option B, a separate interact button and the attack button never talks. hero.scene: Red's scene. hud.scene: the persistent HUD node (the UI Programmer's ActionHud replaces the sandbox HUD stand-in). room_parts: what every ActionRoom adds besides the director (scripts with bind(host)). retry.rule: room_entrance (Decision 2 A, default: continue from the room's entrance with the health and battery she walked in with), last_save (B) or none (she just gets up); credit_cost: credits docked per knock-out (C); auto_continue_s: seconds before the room restarts by itself (the stand-in for the Continue screen; 0 = wait for the UI). look.default_profile: used when a room names none.
new_game_hacks_note: Which hacks a new slice game starts with (placeholder: all four of the pitch; the Combat Designer decides any unlock order).
